title: plan/beats.json — the reel timeline, derived from the measured voice-over
description: The single timing source of an Arabic reel. Written by tools/vo_length.py from the measured VO (helpers fill fps/frames/bounds/scenes), then completed by the agent (theme, events, id, ui). Two legal shapes: the draft (duration null, scenes empty — the new_project scaffold before the VO is measured) and the measured one (duration > 0, contiguous scenes covering [0, duration]). Cross-field invariants (bounds ↔ scenes ↔ duration, frames arithmetic, event containment) are NOT expressible here; they are enforced by tools/beats_check.py and by tools/reel_lint.py. The reel has no target length — duration is the VO length, never a plan.

duration.description: seconds. null = the VO has not been measured yet (draft); otherwise the exact VO length

fps.description: frames per second the reel will render at (vo_length.py defaults to 30)

frames.description: round(duration * fps) — the render range of the whole composition

bounds.description: scene cut points in seconds: starts at 0, ends at duration, non-decreasing, len == scenes + 1

audio.description: path of the VO file the timeline was measured from (as passed to vo_length.py --json)

anyOf.title: draft
anyOf.description: scaffold written by tools/new_project.py before tools/vo_length.py ran — not renderable

anyOf.title: measured
anyOf.description: output of tools/vo_length.py, completed by the agent — renderable once reel_lint passes

id.description: stable slug for the scene (e.g. "one-take"); unique within the file when present

start.description: scene start in seconds, on the VO clock (vo_seconds)

end.description: scene end in seconds; scenes are contiguous — no gaps, no overlaps

dur.description: end - start (written by vo_length.py; kept for convenience)

frames.description: round((end - start) * fps); sums to the top-level frames

theme.description: alternating locked-brand ground for the scene; feeds the T06 contrast checks

ui.description: true = the scene shows an interface that must change (reel_lint U01)

events.description: picture events inside the scene (reveal, cut-in, interaction) with their time

t.description: event time on the VO clock in seconds; must lie inside its scene

what.description: one line describing the visible change ("counter runs", "pose swap")
